A_value: a third-generation spectral wave model developed by ecmwf to simulate surface gravity waves. it solves the wave action balance equation in frequency-direction space, computes the evolution of the wave spectrum, including energy input from wind, nonlinear interactions, dissipation by whitecapping, bottom friction, depth-induced breaking. in the breivik et al. 2015 configuration, ecwam provides stokes drift, water-side stress, turbulent kinetic energy tke flux to nemo.; growth, dissipation, nonlinear interaction coefficients, spectral discretization controls; atmospheric winds, ice fields, optional ocean / ice modifiers; optional surface currents, sea-ice fraction for wave-current, wave-ice effects in coupled mode e.g., ifs-ecwam-nemo framework .
B_value: a state-of-the-art ocean general circulation model for simulating the global ocean, including thermohaline circulation, upper-ocean mixing, sea ice. in the wave-aware configuration of breivik et al. 2015 , nemo ingests stokes drift, sea-state dependent water-side stress, wave-breaking turbulent kinetic energy tke flux from ecwam to represent surface wave effects on currents, mixing.; mixing, drag, coupling controls e.g., etau, langmuir, wave-related switches; standard surface forcing plus wave-induced fields from a spectral wave model ecwam when wave coupling is active; provides surface stokes drift, parameters for the vertical stokes drift profile, sea-state dependent water-side stress, breaking-wave tke flux used as upper boundary conditions in nemo.
AB_value: a coupled wave-ocean modeling system integrating nemo ocean general circulation model , ecwam spectral wave model to account for surface wave effects in ocean dynamics. in the breivik et al. 2015 configuration, ecwam provides sea-state dependent surface stress, stokes drift, turbulent kinetic energy tke flux from breaking waves to nemo, which in turn updates upper-ocean temperature, currents, mixed layer depth. the system can be run in ocean-only forced mode nemo forced by ecwam fields derived from era-interim or as part of a fully coupled ifs-ecwam-nemo configuration.; coupling interval, selection of wave effects tauoc, wtke, stcor , mapping options between grids; stokes drift surface vector, profile parameters, wave-modified water-side stress, wave-breaking tke flux used as boundary conditions in nemo.; sea surface temperature, surface currents fed back to the atmospheric model ifs , indirectly influencing ecwam via changes in stress, roughness.
